### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning                                                                       |
| ----- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | mixing, intersection, crossing, mutuality, association, interchange, exchange |
| ~en   | *v.*   | to exchange (tr.)                                                             |
| ~an   | *adj.* | mutual, inter-                                                                |
| ~un   | *adv.* | each other, one another, mutually                                             |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
交, two legs crossed
#### Sound
- Chinese "jian"
- *a priori:* j=sudden/social (GPT called it "social" so i'm going with that lol), u=deep (as in the area between two things)
